integrity_notes: An analytic proof and exact finite-state checker are included. Same-model review is not independent validation; the priority claim is limited to examined evidence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of hubs, fixed positive cluster weight and activities; no growing-core or uniform-parameter theorem.
No quantitative total-variation rate for the joint Gaussian limit.
The q=1 independent-percolation limit is known separately and is not claimed as new.
Potential broader historical Potts/FK cumulant results may imply this scaling law; historical priority needs independent specialist review.
title: Finite-core Fortuin–Kasteleyn reduction and mixed-Gaussian cluster fluctuations
